title: Add observation-triggered work
supabiz_proposal: Route camera events and staff reports into the same evidence/task system.
measure: Useful tasks discovered before manual reporting

title: Keep observation, inference and action distinct
supabiz_proposal: Represent visual observations separately from business assertions and authorized changes.

title: Start with one visible low-risk event
supabiz_proposal: Begin with table-reset checks under human confirmation.

title: Make camera health a first-class input
supabiz_proposal: Invalidate stale/obscured observations and keep manual work available.

title: Scope state to a table visit
supabiz_proposal: Separate physical table identity from each occupancy episode; reject late prior-visit events.

title: Reconcile sources by field authority
supabiz_proposal: Resolve host, POS, camera and staff evidence without declaring any source globally authoritative.

title: Route by current role and workload
supabiz_proposal: Use current shift assignments, permission and capacity; include named ownership and handoff.

title: Separate acceptance from verified closure
supabiz_proposal: Use explicit accepted, ready-for-check and confirmed outcomes.

title: Pair a floor map with an accessible queue
supabiz_proposal: Give hosts spatial context and staff a short text-based actionable list.
measure: Time to find the correct task

title: Budget attention as well as compute
supabiz_proposal: Deduplicate alerts and set cooldowns, priority and escalation rules.

title: Use reviewed correction categories
supabiz_proposal: Record incorrect location, occlusion, already handled and rule errors separately.

title: Improve with evaluated versions
supabiz_proposal: Test calibration, temporal rules and candidate models on held-out shifts/sites before activation.

title: Treat camera support as an optional module
supabiz_proposal: Add value alongside existing POS and communication channels; do not require replacement.
measure: Onboarding time; time to first verified outcome

title: Keep retention separate for each artifact
supabiz_proposal: Define independent raw-stream, clip, observation and business-record retention and deletion.

title: Give each audience a permitted view
supabiz_proposal: Separate task visibility from raw footage rights; scope every source to site and purpose.

title: Optimize the process before judging people
supabiz_proposal: Measure service queues and coverage; avoid automated personal ratings from ambiguous footage.

title: Measure real economics and coverage
supabiz_proposal: Compare cost per verified task and end-to-end delays against manual baseline; separate payment savings.
measure: Incremental cost, attention load, task benefit

title: Scale with bounded fresh work
supabiz_proposal: Shard capture by camera/site and state by table/visit; explicitly handle stale backlog and overload.
measure: p95 age, drop rate, recovery correctness
